◍

Theme

Each card is drawn in its own colours. What you see is what the reader becomes.
◌

Make me a theme

Describe a room and Smart+ will build the palette for it. Your description and whether you want light or dark are the only things sent.
A place, a time of day, a mood — anything a room could be. Every colour is checked for legibility before it is used.
↻

Follow my reading

The reader can take on the colour of whatever you actually read, moving a little each day. It takes about three weeks to arrive, and it never changes how legible anything is.
Attune the themeYour theme stays your theme — it drifts toward a room built for your interests, one small step per day.
◈

Accent

The colour of the marker that says where you are, and of anything the reader is pointing at.
✎

Reading size

Article typeOnly the article column moves. The line stays 66 characters, so larger type gives a narrower column rather than a longer line.

Good type disappears: you read the sentence rather than the letters, and the line stays short enough that your eye finds the start of the next one.

⚡

Motion

Movement here is used to say where you are and what changed — nothing moves for decoration.
AnimationsFull by default, on every machine. Reduce it and every transition takes zero time: the interface arrives at the state it would have animated to, immediately.
◈

Interface language

Translates every button, label and message in ArticleFlux with the model above. A language you have used before is free — it is cached on the server until the English changes.
English is the language the interface is written in. It is always available and never costs anything.
